file_write.scope: Write only user-selected deck outputs, QA reports, contact sheets, and PDFs. Manifest image paths must stay under slides/. Existing contact sheets and PDFs are preserved unless --overwrite is explicit.
file_write.reason: The workflow must save generated slide assets, record validation evidence, build a contact sheet, and assemble the final PDF.

target_enforcement.openai: metadata-only permission contract plus host workspace approval
target_enforcement.claude: adapter permission contract plus local filesystem approval
target_enforcement.generic: adapter permission contract plus operator approval
target_enforcement.vscode: adapter permission contract plus VS Code workspace trust
